name: UX Analytics, Usability Testing & Impact Measurement
description: Quantitative and qualitative UX measurement: A/B testing, multivariate testing, statistical significance, Usability Testing (SUS), funnel drop-off analytics, HEART framework ROI, and algorithmic personalization.

subskills.name: A/B Testing Methodology & Hypothesis Formulation
subskills.description: Formulating testable hypotheses, defining primary/secondary metrics, and running A/B experiments.

subskills.name: UX KPIs & Core Metrics (CSAT, CES, NPS, TTR)
subskills.description: Tracking Customer Satisfaction (CSAT), Customer Effort Score (CES), Net Promoter Score (NPS), and Time-to-Resolution.

subskills.name: Usability Testing Protocols & System Usability Scale (SUS)
subskills.description: Conducting moderated/unmoderated usability tests, Nielsen's 10 heuristics evaluations, and standard SUS scoring.

subskills.name: Statistical Significance, P-Values & Sample Sizing
subskills.description: Calculating statistical significance (p < 0.05), confidence intervals, statistical power (1 - beta), and minimum sample sizes.

subskills.name: Synthesizing Test Results & Iterative UX Roadmaps
subskills.description: Triangulating qualitative feedback with quantitative test metrics to drive iterative design roadmaps.

subskills.name: Funnel Drop-Off Analytics & Behavioral Cohorts
subskills.description: Analyzing conversion funnels, drop-off milestones, cohort retention curves (Mixpanel, Amplitude, PostHog), and session replay insights.

subskills.name: Multivariate (MVT) & Fractional Factorial Testing
subskills.description: Testing multiple element combinations simultaneously using fractional factorial experimental design.

subskills.name: Google HEART Framework & UX ROI Attribution
subskills.description: Measuring long-term impact with Google HEART (Happiness, Engagement, Adoption, Retention, Task Success) and calculating UX ROI.

subskills.name: Algorithmic & Adaptive UX Impact Measurement
subskills.description: Measuring the user impact of ML-driven adaptive UI personalization, recommendation algorithms, and algorithmic bias testing.

github.signal: Experimentation configs (LaunchDarkly, Statsig), PostHog/Mixpanel tracking events, and usability test plans

cv.signal: Formulated A/B test hypotheses and conducted SUS usability evaluations improving task completion rate from 62% to 91%
Implemented Google HEART framework tracking longitudinal retention and analyzed funnel cohorts in Amplitude/Mixpanel

linkedin.signal: Endorsements in UX Research, A/B Testing, Usability Testing (SUS), Product Analytics, and HEART Framework

assessment.signal: Passes UX analytics assessment covering sample size calculations, SUS usability scoring, funnel cohort retention, and HEART framework ROI

junior.description: Formulates testable A/B hypotheses, tracks CSAT/NPS KPIs, and conducts SUS usability tests.

mid.description: Calculates statistical significance/p-values, analyzes funnel drop-off cohorts, and synthesizes qualitative/quantitative insights.

senior.description: Directs multivariate testing, establishes Google HEART framework tracking, and measures adaptive ML personalization impact.
